title: Lumbar FSU rotation at 5 Nm: no preload vs 400 N preload applied by four different methods (dead weight to follower-type)

quantity.name: rotation at 5 Nm pure moment (includes neutral zone)
quantity.definition: Euler rotation (ZYX) of the upper relative to the lower vertebra at 5 Nm in cycle 2, relative to the cycle-1 balance point; coordinate system fixed to the caudal vertebra with origin at the disc centre

source.authors: Cripton PA, Bruehlmann SB, Orr TE, Oxland TR, Nolte LP
source.sample: 6 lumbar FSUs (1 L1-L2, 3 L2-L3, 1 L3-L4, 1 L4-L5); human cadaveric lumbar FSUs screened for abnormal degeneration

protocol.summary: Pure moments by cable system, 4 equal steps (8 for Type IV) to 5 Nm, 2 cycles (1st preconditioning), 30 s hold per step; preload 20 or 40 kg weights (~200/400 N) applied by Types I-IV; no-load tests before and after (final no-load used as reference). Optotrak kinematics; six-axis load cell under the caudal vertebra (artefact moments and shear also reported).
how_to_simulate: Fix the caudal vertebra of a lumbar FSU; apply pure flexion, extension or right lateral bending moment in 4 steps to 5 Nm

Run without preload, then with 400 N compression applied either as a follower load through the disc centre (compare with Type IV/III) or as a vertical dead load attached above the cranial vertebra (compare with Type I)

Report the rotation at 5 Nm (including the neutral zone) and compare the change relative to the no-preload case (follower-type preload should change ROM little; dead-weight types increase flexion/lateral bending ROM through artefact moments)
protocol.notes: Type definitions: End: no preload (final no-load test; reference); Type I: 400 N dead weight hung from a point above the cranial vertebra, direction vertical, unconstrained; Type II: 400 N, Type I with cable guides below the specimen; Type III: 400 N, cable attachment and guide points level with the upper/lower endplate edges; Type IV: 400 N, follower-type: preload vector kept parallel to/realigned with the cranial endplate after each step. Artefact moments with Type I/II 400 N were +40-94% (Type I) and +40-50% (Type II) of the applied 5 Nm (text). Torsion not digitised (Type IV not applicable).

extraction.uncertainty: +-0.1 deg for separated markers (1 px = 0.021 deg at 300 dpi; marker centre +-3 px), +-0.2 deg where markers overlap; curve identity from line style (moderate confidence for thin lines)
extraction.check_notes: Endpoint markers located by pixel blob analysis against dotted gridlines (2-deg spacing) and re-read visually from the 300 dpi crop; flexion values: Type II 6.79, Type I 6.39, End 6.05 consistent with text (Types I/II ROM larger than no-load). Intermediate moment steps not extracted.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 0.5 deg (no SD reported), and correct sign of change vs no-preload for each preload type
